author: Murphh
body:
Can both a mini and a regular walls map be available at all times to play for walls? 

Today we are running in the the problem where only mini maps are in rotations and more than 12 players want to play.  So when the map starts, some players don't get to play.  Mini maps are limited to only 12 players. 

Can only map developers fix rotations? Or can we ask mods/sr mods to help if they are online?

replies.author: ItzAidan
replies.body: I talked to 2 mods and they said they talked to MapDevs and they said they hope it gets fixed soon. So mods can't fix it but they can communicate with MapDevs in fact that's the Buzz of Avicus right now of a glitch with walls. Apperantly all kinds of mods have been notified abut the walls rotation and mini walls things so they will get right on it. And maybe(I'm just suggesting) You guys should do 3 big walls map and 1 mini walls map. Mini walls gets boring fast and we want big walls maps again. In my opinion, there should be no mini maps at all because its just no fun. Also there is a glitch in CTH just informing you guys.
